# Model 4 — Artificial Neural Network

The original ANN tried six cross-validation fits plus a final model and could take a long time to knit. To keep the class `neuralnet()` approach practical, I compare **one versus two hidden neurons on one training-only validation split**. I cap the sample used to train this computationally expensive model at 2,500 historical players. All 2022–2025 players still receive predictions, and none are used for tuning. This smaller training sample is a computational compromise, not an improvement in predictive accuracy.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load the scaled predictors and training outcomes from data preparation.
train_x_scaled <- readRDS("objects/train_x_scaled.rds")
test_x_scaled <- readRDS("objects/test_x_scaled.rds")
train_y <- readRDS("objects/train_y.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)

# Select up to 2,500 historical players while preserving class proportions.
set.seed(12345)
ann_n <- min(2500, length(train_y))

ann_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(
    train_y,
    p = ann_n / length(train_y),
    list = FALSE
  )
)

ann_data <- data.frame(
  y = as.integer(train_y[ann_rows] == "Drafted"),
  train_x_scaled[ann_rows, , drop = FALSE]
)

# Split the ANN sample into 80% fitting and 20% validation.
set.seed(12345)

fit_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(ann_data$y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
)

val_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(ann_data)), fit_rows)

# Compare one hidden neuron against two hidden neurons.
ann_cv <- data.frame(
  Hidden = c(1, 2),
  Accuracy = NA_real_,
  Kappa = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ann_cv))) {

  cat("Fitting ANN candidate", i, "of", nrow(ann_cv), "\n")

  set.seed(12345 + i)

  # Limit training steps to prevent excessively long model fitting.
  trial <- neuralnet(
    y ~ .,
    data = ann_data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE],
    hidden = ann_cv$Hidden[i],
    linear.output = FALSE,
    threshold = 0.1,
    stepmax = 20000
  )

  # Predict probabilities for the validation sample.
  val_prob <- as.numeric(
    predict(trial, ann_data[val_rows, -1, drop = FALSE])
  )

  # Convert probabilities into classifications for evaluation.
  val_pred <- factor(
    ifelse(val_prob >= 0.5, "Drafted", "Undrafted"),
    levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
  )

  val_actual <- factor(
    ifelse(ann_data$y[val_rows] == 1, "Drafted", "Undrafted"),
    levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
  )

  cm <- confusionMatrix(
    val_pred,
    val_actual,
    positive = "Drafted"
  )

  ann_cv$Accuracy[i] <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
  ann_cv$Kappa[i] <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"])
}

# Review both models and select the highest validation Kappa.
print(ann_cv)

chosen_hidden <- ann_cv$Hidden[
  order(-ann_cv$Kappa, -ann_cv$Accuracy)[1]
]

# Refit the selected network on the complete sampled historical group.
cat(
  "Fitting final ANN with",
  chosen_hidden,
  "hidden neuron(s) on",
  nrow(ann_data),
  "historical players\n"
)

set.seed(12345)

ann_model <- neuralnet(
  y ~ .,
  data = ann_data,
  hidden = chosen_hidden,
  linear.output = FALSE,
  threshold = 0.1,
  stepmax = 20000
)

# Generate predictions for every player in the future-year test set.
ann_prob <- as.numeric(predict(ann_model, test_x_scaled))

ann_pred <- factor(
  ifelse(ann_prob >= 0.5, "Drafted", "Undrafted"),
  levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
)

# Confirm that every test player received a valid probability.
stopifnot(
  length(ann_prob) == nrow(test_x_scaled),
  all(is.finite(ann_prob))
)
```






## **6.1 Baseline Model**

```{r}
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)

# Select up to 2,500 historical players while preserving class proportions.
set.seed(12345)
ann_n <- min(2500, length(train_y))

ann_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(
    train_y,
    p = ann_n / length(train_y),
    list = FALSE
  )
)

ann_data <- data.frame(
  y = as.integer(train_y[ann_rows] == "Drafted"),
  train_x_scaled[ann_rows, , drop = FALSE]
)

# Split the ANN sample into 80% fitting and 20% validation.
set.seed(12345)

fit_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(ann_data$y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
)

val_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(ann_data)), fit_rows)

```

```{r}
simplemodel <- neuralnet(
  y ~ .,
  data = ann_data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE],
  hidden = 1,
  linear.output = FALSE,
  stepmax = 1e8,
  lifesign = "full"
)

plot(simplemodel, rep = 1)
```


## **6.2 Improving the Model**

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MODEL 4: IMPROVED NFL DRAFT ANN
# Exhaustive Architecture Search:
# 1, 2 and 3 Hidden Layers
# ============================================================

library(neuralnet)
library(caret)

set.seed(12345)

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: PREPARE ANN TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================

# Select up to approximately 2,500 historical players

ann_n <- min(2500, length(train_y))

ann_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(
    train_y,
    p = ann_n / length(train_y),
    list = FALSE
  )
)

ann_data <- data.frame(
  y = as.integer(train_y[ann_rows] == "Drafted"),
  train_x_scaled[ann_rows, , drop = FALSE]
)

# Check predictor data

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(ann_data[, -1, drop = FALSE])))) {
  stop("Missing or non-finite predictor values found.")
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: CREATE TRAINING AND VALIDATION SETS
# ============================================================

set.seed(12345)

fit_rows <- as.vector(
  createDataPartition(
    ann_data$y,
    p = 0.80,
    list = FALSE
  )
)

val_rows <- setdiff(
  seq_len(nrow(ann_data)),
  fit_rows
)

ann_training <- ann_data[
  fit_rows, ,
  drop = FALSE
]

ann_validation <- ann_data[
  val_rows, ,
  drop = FALSE
]

validation_X <- ann_validation[, -1, drop = FALSE]

validation_y <- ann_validation$y

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: GENERATE ANN ARCHITECTURES
# One and Two Hidden Layers Only
# ============================================================

# Set neuron range for each hidden layer

min_neurons <- 1
max_neurons <- 6

neuron_range <- min_neurons:max_neurons

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ONE HIDDEN LAYER: X
# ------------------------------------------------------------

architectures_1 <- lapply(
  neuron_range,
  function(x) as.integer(x)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TWO HIDDEN LAYERS: X-X
# ------------------------------------------------------------

grid_2 <- expand.grid(
  layer1 = neuron_range,
  layer2 = neuron_range
)

architectures_2 <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(grid_2)),
  function(i) {
    as.integer(unlist(grid_2[i, ]))
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE ARCHITECTURES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

architectures <- c(
  architectures_1,
  architectures_2
)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("ANN ARCHITECTURE SEARCH\n")
cat("====================================\n")

cat(
  "One hidden layer:",
  length(architectures_1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Two hidden layers:",
  length(architectures_2),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total architectures:",
  length(architectures),
  "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: INITIALISE RESULTS
# ============================================================

ann_cv <- data.frame(
  Architecture = character(),
  Hidden_Layers = integer(),
  Total_Neurons = integer(),
  Accuracy = numeric(),
  Kappa = numeric(),
  Sensitivity = numeric(),
  Specificity = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: TRAIN AND VALIDATE ALL ARCHITECTURES
# ============================================================

for (i in seq_along(architectures)) {
  
  hidden <- architectures[[i]]
  
  architecture_name <- paste(
    hidden,
    collapse = "-"
  )
  
  cat(
    "\nTesting architecture",
    i,
    "of",
    length(architectures),
    ":",
    architecture_name,
    "\n"
  )
  
  set.seed(12345 + i)
  
  # Train ANN
  
  trial <- tryCatch(
    
    neuralnet(
      y ~ .,
      data = ann_training,
      hidden = hidden,
      linear.output = FALSE,
      threshold = 0.1,
      stepmax = 20000,
      lifesign = "minimal"
    ),
    
    error = function(e) {
      
      message(
        "Training failed for ",
        architecture_name,
        ": ",
        e$message
      )
      
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(trial)) next
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # VALIDATION PREDICTIONS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  val_prob <- tryCatch(
    
    as.numeric(
      predict(
        trial,
        validation_X
      )
    ),
    
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (
    is.null(val_prob) ||
    length(val_prob) != length(validation_y) ||
    any(!is.finite(val_prob))
  ) {
    next
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFY PREDICTIONS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  val_pred <- factor(
    ifelse(
      val_prob >= 0.50,
      "Drafted",
      "Undrafted"
    ),
    levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
  )
  
  val_actual <- factor(
    ifelse(
      validation_y == 1,
      "Drafted",
      "Undrafted"
    ),
    levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CONFUSION MATRIX AND PERFORMANCE METRICS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  cm <- tryCatch(
    
    confusionMatrix(
      val_pred,
      val_actual,
      positive = "Drafted"
    ),
    
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(cm)) next
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # STORE RESULTS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ann_cv <- rbind(
    ann_cv,
    
    data.frame(
      Architecture = architecture_name,
      Hidden_Layers = length(hidden),
      Total_Neurons = sum(hidden),
      
      Accuracy = as.numeric(
        cm$overall["Accuracy"]
      ),
      
      Kappa = as.numeric(
        cm$overall["Kappa"]
      ),
      
      Sensitivity = as.numeric(
        cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
      ),
      
      Specificity = as.numeric(
        cm$byClass["Specificity"]
      )
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: RANK ANN ARCHITECTURES
# ============================================================

if (nrow(ann_cv) == 0) {
  stop("No ANN architectures were successfully trained.")
}

# Rank by Kappa, followed by Accuracy

ann_cv <- ann_cv[
  order(
    -ann_cv$Kappa,
    -ann_cv$Accuracy,
    na.last = TRUE
  ),
]

rownames(ann_cv) <- NULL

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("ANN ARCHITECTURE SEARCH RESULTS\n")
cat("====================================\n")

print(ann_cv)

cat(
  "\nSuccessfully evaluated architectures:",
  nrow(ann_cv),
  "out of",
  length(architectures),
  "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 7: SELECT BEST ANN ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================

best_architecture <- ann_cv[1, , drop = FALSE]

best_hidden <- as.integer(
  strsplit(
    best_architecture$Architecture,
    "-"
  )[[1]]
)

chosen_hidden <- best_hidden

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("BEST ANN ARCHITECTURE\n")
cat("====================================\n")

cat(
  "Architecture:",
  best_architecture$Architecture,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of hidden layers:",
  length(best_hidden),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Neurons per hidden layer:",
  paste(best_hidden, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Validation Accuracy:",
  round(best_architecture$Accuracy, 4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Validation Kappa:",
  round(best_architecture$Kappa, 4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Validation Sensitivity:",
  round(best_architecture$Sensitivity, 4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Validation Specificity:",
  round(best_architecture$Specificity, 4),
  "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 8: TRAIN FINAL ANN MODEL
# ============================================================

# Refit the selected architecture using all sampled
# historical training observations

set.seed(12345)

ann_model <- neuralnet(
  y ~ .,
  data = ann_data,
  hidden = chosen_hidden,
  linear.output = FALSE,
  threshold = 0.1,
  stepmax = 20000,
  lifesign = "full"
)

# Retain original project model name

improved_ANN_model <- ann_model

# ============================================================
# STEP 9: PLOT FINAL ANN MODEL
# ============================================================

plot(
  ann_model,
  rep = 1
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 10: PREDICT NFL DRAFT OUTCOMES
# ============================================================

# Predict probabilities for 2022-2025 players

ann_prob <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    ann_model,
    test_x_scaled
  )
)

# Convert probabilities into classifications

ann_pred <- factor(
  ifelse(
    ann_prob >= 0.50,
    "Drafted",
    "Undrafted"
  ),
  levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")
)

# Check prediction validity

stopifnot(
  length(ann_prob) == nrow(test_x_scaled),
  all(is.finite(ann_prob))
)

# Create prediction table

ANN_pred_table <- data.frame(
  Predicted_Probability = ann_prob,
  Predicted_Class = ann_pred
)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("NFL DRAFT PREDICTIONS\n")
cat("====================================\n")

print(head(ANN_pred_table))

# ============================================================
# STEP 11: SAVE MODEL RESULTS
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  ann_cv,
  "NFL_ANN_Architecture_Results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  ANN_pred_table,
  "NFL_ANN_Predictions.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nANN architecture search completed successfully.\n")
```


## **6.3 Final Model**









```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
# Save the fitted model, tuning results, and final predictions.
saveRDS(ann_model, "objects/ann_model.rds")
saveRDS(ann_cv, "objects/ann_cv.rds")
saveRDS(ann_prob, "objects/ann_prob.rds")
saveRDS(ann_pred, "objects/ann_pred.rds")

# Save the selected settings for the consolidated report.
saveRDS(chosen_hidden, "objects/ann_hidden.rds")
saveRDS(nrow(ann_data), "objects/ann_training_n.rds")
```
